_contract: Which artifact repository this deployment's sessions fetch from and publish to. A DEPLOYMENT fact, not a framework one: the reusable core describes what a relay input IS, and this says where the objects live. AUTHORIZES NOTHING.
_why_not_in_src: a concrete repository id in src/aadistill would make the reusable core name one organisation's storage; a second deployment would have to edit the framework rather than its own configuration.
